title: Residential Interior
summary: Homes designed around how you actually live.
description: From a single room to a full villa, we design homes that start with your routine — where the school bags land, where the morning light should hit, where you actually eat dinner. Layouts, lighting, joinery and finishes are resolved together, so nothing is decorated over.
Every project includes 3D views of the main rooms, a fixed quotation before work begins, and one point of contact from first sketch to handover.

title: Commercial Interior
summary: Spaces built to perform, not just look good.
description: Clinics, salons, showrooms and studios: rooms where the interior has to earn its keep. We design for footfall, maintenance and brand — durable materials, serviceable details and layouts that move customers or patients the way you need them to move.
Commercial work is quoted per square foot with phased delivery, so your business keeps trading while we build.

title: Office & Corporate
summary: Workplaces shaped around people and purpose.
description: Offices that people genuinely want to arrive at. We plan for the four modes of modern work — focus, collaboration, meeting and recharge — with acoustics, ergonomics and daylight treated as design materials, not afterthoughts.
From executive floors to startup lofts, every workstation, quiet booth and coffee point is placed with intent and drawn to detail.

title: Retail & Shop
summary: Interiors that turn attention into connection.
description: Stores are measured in dwell time and basket size, so we design journeys: a facade that stops footfall, a threshold that sets the mood, displays that invite touch, and a counter that closes the sale. Materials are chosen for beauty under retail lighting and for surviving ten thousand touches.
Bespoke display joinery comes from our own workshop — built once, built right.

title: Brand Shop & Outlet
summary: Franchise-ready interiors your brand can repeat.
description: One flagship, then ten more: we design brand environments as systems — a kit of joinery, lighting and finish standards that can be rolled out city by city without losing the plot. Every element is documented so any contractor can build to the same line.
Perfect for fashion, food and lifestyle brands scaling across Pakistan's malls and high streets.

title: Office Fit-Out
summary: From bare shell to switch-on in one schedule.
description: Take an empty floor and hand back a working office: partitions, ceilings, flooring, MEP, data, furniture and signage under one contract and one schedule. We coordinate landlords, approvals and IT teams so your move-in date is a promise, not a hope.
Cat A and Cat B fit-outs delivered for teams of ten to three hundred.

title: Commercial Fit-Out
summary: Clinics, salons and studios — delivered open-on-time.
description: Specialist commercial spaces with technical hearts: dental surgeries, salons, labs and clinics where plumbing, power, sterilisation and equipment drive the plan. We coordinate equipment suppliers early so the interior fits the machines — not the other way round.
Delivered with compliance documentation and staff walkthrough training at handover.

title: Residential Fit-Out
summary: Your apartment, finished to showroom level.
description: The last twenty percent of a home is where quality shows: skirting that meets flooring perfectly, doors hung flush, paint finished like furniture. We take builder-finish apartments to move-in condition with flooring, ceilings, bathrooms, kitchens and joinery under one team.
Ideal for new DHA and Bahria possessions — bring us the keys, we bring the schedule.

title: Restaurant Interior
summary: Atmosphere, flow, and a reason to return.
description: A restaurant interior is a machine for evenings: kitchen flow that servers never curse, banquettes that keep noise at conversation level, lighting that makes food and faces look their best at 8pm. We design the whole machine — then our workshop builds the parts that matter.
Covers, turnover and average check are design inputs here, not afterthoughts.

title: Café Interior
description: Cafés live or die by Instagram and repeatability. We design a hero moment — the counter, the banquette, the light at 4pm — and build the whole room to support it. Robust materials, quick-clean details and seating that turns four times a day without looking tired.
From 400 sq.ft espresso bars to two-storey specialty houses.

title: Custom Furniture & Joinery
summary: Made to fit the room exactly.
description: Our workshop is the heart of Woodex. Kitchens, wardrobes, vanities, libraries, doors and desks — designed to the millimetre for your walls, built from certified oak, walnut and birch plywood with hardware that closes like a good car door.
Every piece is signed, dated and covered by our ten-year warranty.

title: Interior Renovation
summary: Old bones, new life — without demolishing your calendar.
description: Renovation is surgery, not decoration: we diagnose what the building will allow — structure, plumbing, levels, light — then design the smallest intervention with the biggest result. Most renovations run while you keep living or trading in the space.
Phased works, dust control and daily site photos come as standard.

The way embassies, hoteliers and busy families prefer to build.

Also available as a standalone service for architects, developers and private clients with their own drawings.
